stories.story_title: New pollock simulation testbed separates forecasting from fishing decisions
stories.summary_2_sentences: A September 11 paper tests neural networks on fisheries forecasting, spatial estimation and harvest-policy discovery. Eastern Bering Sea pollock anchors the forecast and policy simulations.

sources.access_note: Canonical open returned full article redirect with 2686 lines, but subsequent opens intermittently fail safety checks. Exact web searches for fsag176 Results return full publisher text.
README still says in review; published date comes from journal.

exact_facts: Kapur, Adams and Thorson list NOAA Alaska Fisheries Science Center affiliations.
Forecast experiment: 300 simulated 30-year replicates per growth scenario, six models, pollock-based parameters.
LSTM leads constant-growth prediction; under changing growth, the five-year mean performs best two years ahead.
Spatial experiment: neither CNN approach outperforms tinyVAST.

Policy experiment: 25 replicates; operating model conditioned on 1964–2024 observations, projections 2025–2050. Reinforcement learning learns harvest rules by reward feedback; some learned policies cause large catch fluctuations.
stories.quote: the case study methods are examples and are not final
stories.caveat: Illustrative simulations, not operational quota adoption or measured fishery improvements. Do not conflate forecasting with policy decisions.
stories.human_story_fuel: Editorial angle: test decisions in simulated seasons before livelihoods face them.
stories.local_sentiment: No independent Alaska fisher reaction located; do not invent consensus.

stories.story_title: Under-ice modem fieldwork with UIC Science
stories.summary_2_sentences: MIT researchers worked with UIC Science in Utqiaġvik to test magnetic communication through ice. The test achieved approximately 1.2 kilobytes per second through 3.6 feet of ice using an ROV-mounted Havguard prototype.
stories.human_story_fuel: Blizzards delayed fieldwork; UIC Science taught researchers snowmobile travel, and the visitors helped at a children's snowmobile race and taught middle-school sonar concepts.
stories.quote: the weather is in charge of our access to the Arctic
stories.genuine_ai_mechanism: Machine learning for separating icequakes from marine-mammal sounds is proposed future collaboration, not the demonstrated modem mechanism.
stories.caveat: Lower priority: robot communications story with future AI only. Fieldwork happened March and mid-April; September 8 aggregators incorrectly frame it as September fieldwork.
stories.local_sentiment: Named UIC Science involvement; no independent local reaction reported.

context_source.use: Human stakes for simulation story: survey consistency underpins catch advice and fishermen's season planning. AFSC's Stan Kotwicki urges calibration and parallel testing for new survey tools.
context_source.caveat: AlaskaAI carousel already covered this September 6; context only, not a fresh second story. Survey technology framework is separate from September 11 neural-network paper.
